title: Entry: the NBA tab
note: v1.1: your team is the second chip (1 press from Games). The hero is your team's next game whatever day is picked.

title: Entry: shield on
note: Shield on, the Kings game unseen: the hero's record is counted from seen games only (2-0 + eye-off).

title: Entry: hold OK on a game card
note: Hold OK on a game card: both team pages. The menu now ends at y 513 (it opens upward when it must).

title: Standings: top
note: West first. W, L and PCT 16 px, GB / HOME / ROAD 14 px; the 22 px LIVE pill; no divider next to your row.

title: Standings: your row focused
note: Inset ring on the Grizzlies row. OK opens the team page. Row 8 is the lowest a focused row sits in this layout.

title: Standings: scrolled
note: Past row 8 the bar and the chips slide away; the column names stay at y 52.

title: Standings: shield on
note: The West as pinned at the Kings game's tip-off, both teams' rows included. Focus on West; Reveal names its one game.

title: Standings: shield, no copy
note: No pinned copy (rare): the West is covered. Show the East is focused; Reveal is a button you move to.

title: Leaders: points
note: Category column (switches on focus after 250 ms), the leader on their team plate, 2 to 10 below.

title: Leaders: a row focused
note: Rebounds, Cameron Boozer (your team) focused. OK opens his player card over Leaders.

title: Leaders: OK on a player
note: v1.1: OK on a leader opens his card here, with a "Grizzlies page" button; Back returns to his row.

title: Leaders: shield on
note: Shield on: the list pinned at the Kings tip-off (Jerome 36.5 over 2 games). Focus stays on the category.

title: Team stats: assists
note: The column shows your team's rank in each; the list scrolls so your team is in view (T-18th).

title: News: list and preview
note: v1.1: newest first; fantasy, betting, video and WNBA stories filtered out.

title: News: shield on
note: Covered: a Kings preview ("on 3-game slide": the opponent rule) and the Grizzlies preview ("4th straight win").

title: News: OK on a covered story
note: OK on a covered story: Keep it hidden is focused; Reveal names the game and is a button you move to.

title: News: the article sheet
note: OK on a story: the full text from ESPN. ▲▼ scroll it, Back closes.

title: News: reader, shield All games
note: Shield All games: the body is scanned before it shows; the paragraph with "108-101 win" is replaced.

title: Team: top
note: Same buttons as the hub hero (one state table). The next game's time sits on its label line; the opponent gets the full line.

title: Team: schedule rail
note: Left from the next game: results. The tile past x 912 shows its surface only (no sliced text).

title: Team: ranks and news
note: Down from the schedule: the page slides up, the bar steps away. Rank tiles, the team's news, the roster.

title: Team: roster scrolled
note: Roster with season averages; column names stay at y 92; long names and players who haven't played.

title: Team: player sheet
note: OK on a roster row: the player's card. Its button jumps to the leaders list he is in.

title: Team: shield on
note: Shield on: record from seen games (2-0 + eye-off), no seed or streak, the Kings tile hidden.

title: Team: shield on, scrolled
note: Ranks from the copy pinned at tip-off (labelled), covered stories, roster sorted by jersey, points hidden.

title: Team: shield on, player card
note: Shield on: MIN, REB, AST only; no leaders button; the roster sorts by jersey, not points.

title: Team: the opponent, shield on
note: My team mode still covers the Kings: an unseen final's scope is both teams. 0-2 + eye-off, the tile hidden.

title: Team: another team
note: Any team: the same page in its colours, with Make my team. "vs Grizzlies" now has its full line.

title: State: ESPN down
note: ESPN not answering: the copy stays, no LIVE pills, the time once. Try again is reachable, not focused.

title: State: loading
note: First visit, nothing cached: flat blocks in the final layout, focus stays on the chip.
